items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And then they had a girl named Ann Robinson, that could scat like Leo Watson.

ctx.x: How long had PeeWee been on the scene then? Do you know?
No, I don't. And then they had a girl named Ann Robinson, that could scat like Leo Watson. And she had a big mouth like Martha Raye, only bigger. And she had a nice figure.
Tom Whaley told me about her.
